fields.summary: REST API validate method does not specify schema location

comments.body:
Schema is available at http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/validation.xsd

schemaLocation needs adding to response

The validate method is also not generating schema-valid responses when the asOfDateTime parameter is not provided, e.g.:

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><validation xmlns="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/access/" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/access/ http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/validation.xsd" pid="test-rest:1" valid="true">
<asOfDateTime></asOfDateTime>
<contentModels>
<model>info:fedora/fedora-system:FedoraObject-3.0</model>
</contentModels>
<problems>
</problems>
<datastreamProblems>
</datastreamProblems>
</validation>
Fixed in 6e65bf3b6ead3336dbf21e8a8263ceef8864a21e. Just needs to have the new validation.xsd uploaded to web server.

Schema uses the access namespace, but the method is in management (and is documented as such) - do we need to modify the schema and the output?

(and, do we need a cross-check of other API methods to check they are using the correct namespace?)
Latest validation.xsd is now up, but still getting the build error: https://bamboo.duraspace.org/build/viewTestCaseResult.action?buildKey=FCREPO-LINUXSAN&buildNumber=117&testCaseResultId=5341203

The test failure is not due to xml schema validation - that is currently disabled for that method (due to the output not matching the schema). The error is because it is doing an xpath test on the output (not as part of the validation but as part of the main test for this method) and the namespace is now incorrect, needs changing from access to management.
